select p1.`month`, p1.income, p1.disburse, -- p1.surplus, ifnull(p2.surplus,0) totalBalance from ( SELECT months.`month`, sum(ifnull(p.income,0)) income, sum(ifnull(p.disburse,0)) disburse, sum(ifnull(p.income,0))-sum(ifnull(p.disburse,0)) surplus
FROM ( SELECT 1 AS `month` UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) AS months left join ( SELECT YEAR(check_date) `year`, MONTH(check_date) `month`, case when check_type = '0' then check_amount else 0 end as disburse, case when check_type = '1' then check_amount else 0 end as income FROM brt_check where YEAR(check_date) = #{year} and order_type = #{orderType} ) p on p.`month` = months.`month` GROUP BY months.`month` ORDER BY months.`month` )p1 LEFT JOIN( select months.`month`, sum(ifnull(p.income,0))- sum(ifnull(p.disburse,0)) surplus
from ( SELECT 1 AS `month` UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) months
left join ( SELECT MONTH(check_date) `month`, case when check_type = '0' then check_amount else 0 end as disburse, case when check_type = '1' then check_amount else 0 end as income FROM brt_check where YEAR(check_date) = #{year} and order_type = #{orderType} ) p on p.`month` <= months.`month`
where months.`month`<= #{month}
GROUP BY months.`month` ) p2 on p2.`month` = p1.`month`

SELECT c.account_id, a.account_name as month, sum(case when check_type = '0' then check_amount else 0 end) as disburse, sum(case when check_type = '1' then check_amount else 0 end) as income, (t.income - t.disburse) as totalBalance FROM brt_check c left join brt_account a on c.account_id = a.account_id left join ( SELECT A.account_id, sum(case when check_type = '0' then check_amount else 0 end) as disburse, sum(case when check_type = '1' then check_amount else 0 end) as income FROM brt_check A where YEAR(A.check_date) = #{year} and A.order_type = #{orderType} group by A.account_id )t on t.account_id = c.account_id where YEAR(c.check_date) = #{year} and c.order_type = #{orderType} and MONTH(c.check_date) = #{month} GROUP BY c.account_id
